references.note: Approved disc, lighting and camera; do not copy its creature.
Native shape: a muscular fair-haired man in slate-grey scale armour rising from a coiled cobalt-blue serpent tail with pale belly bands, gripping a long trident across his body.
Shipped naga tidewarden (brown-skinned, round shield, brown-grey tail): the myrmidon is fair-skinned in steel armour with a cobalt blue tail and a two-handed trident, no shield.

prompt_fields.subject: A naga warrior seen from a steep overhead three-quarter angle, drawn compact and smaller: the upper body of a muscular fair-skinned blond man in slate-grey scale armour with steel pauldrons and dark bracers, both hands gripping a short-shafted trident held upright and close in front of the chest so its bright steel head stays just above his shoulder, rising from a thick coiled serpent tail in bright cobalt blue with a wide pale cream-white banded belly, the coil forming a tight open spiral at the base directly under him. Everything stays tightly clustered in the middle of the disc. Fierce, armoured and complete.
prompt_fields.contrast: Naga tokens: naga tidewarden (brown man, round shield, brown-grey tail), naga tidecaller (hooded dark caster), Lady Nashva (teal woman, water), Lady Zoisla (orange-red tail woman). The myrmidon is the steel-armoured fair man with a diagonal two-handed trident and a bright cobalt-blue tail with cream belly bands (silhouette: diagonal trident plus open tail spiral, no shield; hue: cobalt blue and steel grey; value: mid-light).
prompt_fields.composition: One compact complete creature on a single circular tabletop disc, steep overhead three-quarter camera; visible clear neutral base ring on every side. Keep all anatomy and equipment well inside the inner four-fifths of disc radius. Base brightness must visually match reference neutral disc, with no illumination spill or ground effects. Disc plate discipline: measured results show generations of this style reference tend to render the disc DARKER than the reference, never lighter. So do not darken the disc at all: render the neutral disc -- including the whole outer-sixth ring band and the area under the creature -- at the style reference's own brightness, if anything a hair lighter, and never darker. No warm cast, glow, bounce-light, gradient or vignette anywhere on the disc. Do not darken the creature to compensate either. Add no warm cast, glow, bounce-light, gradient or vignette to the disc anywhere, including directly under or behind dark-bodied creatures. Calibration from the previous generation of this exact token: it drew the trident (and part of the tail) reaching far past the edge of the disc, so the token could not be exported. This time draw the naga markedly smaller and tighter: the ENTIRE figure, including the whole trident and every tail coil, fits inside a circle of about two thirds of the disc radius around the disc centre, leaving a wide bare charcoal ring of base plate on every side.
prompt_fields.palette: Bright cobalt-blue tail with cream belly bands, mid slate-grey scale armour with lighter steel highlights, fair skin and blond hair, bright steel trident; nothing darker than mid tone except armour seams. Dry neutral charcoal disc with restrained copper-grey bevel, kept a visibly lighter value than the creature's darkest parts so the two never merge.
